description: This file defines styling rules and classes for modal dialogs within a Bootstrap-based project, including layout, positioning, appearance, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: modal-open
classes.description: Body class to disable scrolling when modal is active.

classes.name: modal
classes.description: Container element for the modal dialog, handling display, positioning, and fade transitions.

classes.name: modal-dialog
classes.description: Wrapper that positions the modal on the screen.

classes.name: modal-content
classes.description: Main content container of the modal, styled with background, border, and shadow.

classes.name: modal-backdrop
classes.description: Overlay background behind the modal for emphasis and focus.

classes.name: modal-header
classes.description: Header section containing title and close button.

classes.name: modal-title
classes.description: Title text within the modal header.

classes.name: modal-body
classes.description: Content area of the modal where main content resides.

classes.name: modal-scrollbar-measure
classes.description: Utility element to measure scrollbar width.

classes.name: modal-sm
classes.description: Small modal size for larger viewports.

classes.name: modal-lg
classes.description: Large modal size for larger viewports.
